CustomField.description: Qualification standing for this weapon, recalculated whenever a report runs. Filter reports to the current record per officer+weapon (Is_Current_Qual__c = TRUE).
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Period_End__c), "", IF( ISPICKVAL(Qualified__c, "No"), "Retest Required", IF( TODAY() > Next_Due_Date__c, "Overdue", IF( TODAY() > Period_End__c, "Due", "Current"))))
CustomField.label: Due Status
